with combined discretionary earnings of roughly $82K.

The wedding network revenue is driven almost entirely by inbound sponsored

posts. Marketing agencies and advertisers find the sites through Google and

public relations databases like Cision and Pitchbox, then reach out directly via

email. The current owner spends less than an hour per day processing those

Both properties benefit from deep domain authority built over decades. The

wedding network of sites dates back to 1996, and the lifestyle site has been

online since 2011, with a domain authority of 52. Neither business relies on

paid traffic. All revenue is inbound.

The current owner operated both businesses as a deliberate side income alongside

his primary car wash operations. He ran them conservatively and passively.

A buyer who applies even moderate effort to email marketing, SEO content

refreshes, and outbound advertiser outreach could increase revenue without

building anything from scratch.

Both sites run on WordPress, require no custom development, and can be managed
